## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: When this story is complete, the new prompt fragment plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md exists with: (a) frozen-field enumeration as a positive constraint; (b) explicit read-then-copy for cited_excerpt with __UNREADABLE__ sentinel; (c) schema-only scope preamble

## TDD Requirement
Instruction-file task — non-executable LLM instruction file per behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5. No RED test task required.

The file plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md must contain structural elements verifiable by grep/test -f.

Three prompt-fragment safeguards from epic Prompt Alignment Findings must be present verbatim:
1. Frozen-field enumeration as a POSITIVE constraint: explicitly list severity, category, description, file_path, line_range, finding_id as fields that must be copied verbatim from the original findings
2. cited_excerpt read-then-copy with __UNREADABLE__ sentinel: instruct reviewer to re-read the source file content at cited line range; if unreadable, use the sentinel value __UNREADABLE__ (never hallucinate)
3. Schema-only scope preamble: the correction prompt must be scoped ONLY to fixing schema violations; do NOT add new findings, change severity values, or re-evaluate the diff

These safeguards mitigate LLM behavioral risks: Sycophancy #9 (don't downgrade critical findings), Phantom Capability #13 (don't invent unread file content), Confidence Calibration #15 (don't expand scope).

Implement them as specified in epic description — do not paraphrase.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Prompt fragment file exists at correct path
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md
- [ ] File contains frozen-field enumeration with all 6 required fields
  Verify: grep -q 'severity' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md && grep -q 'cited_excerpt' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md && grep -q 'finding_id' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md
- [ ] File contains __UNREADABLE__ sentinel for cited_excerpt
  Verify: grep -q '__UNREADABLE__' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md
- [ ] File contains schema-only scope preamble (no new findings, no severity changes)
  Verify: grep -qi 'schema' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md && grep -qi 'scope' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-schema-correction.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Create reviewer-schema-correction.md prompt fragment with frozen-field and schema-scope safeguards
